tags.name: Mock Access Data Store — Prior Authority
tags.description: Mock of the Access Data Store endpoint that accepts prior-authority submissions.

tags: Mock Access Data Store — Prior Authority
post.summary: Submit a prior-authority request against an application
post.description: Accepts a prior-authority submission for the given application. Repeated submissions for the same applicationId return the same submission ID (idempotent).

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: ID of the application this prior-authority request is for.

201.description: Submission accepted by the Access Data Store.

400.description: Validation failed on the submission body.

Apportionment.description: How the expert's costs are shared with other parties. Present when costsSharedWithOtherParties is true; omitted when it is false.

partiesSharingCosts.description: Total number of parties sharing the costs, including the client.

clientShareAmount.description: The client's share of the costs, in GBP.

CounselDetails.description: The counsel requested. Required when priorAuthorityType is COUNSEL.

counselType.description: Type of counsel being applied for.

DisbursementDetails.description: The disbursement requested. Required when priorAuthorityType is DISBURSEMENT.

disbursementAmount.description: Cost of the disbursement in GBP, exclusive of VAT.

ExpertCosts.description: What the expert will cost, how they will be billed, and how the costs are shared.

billingType.description: Whether the expert is billed hourly or at a flat rate.

hourlyRate.description: Hourly rate in GBP. Required when billingType is HOURLY.

timeRequested.description: Time requested. Required when billingType is HOURLY.

totalAmount.description: Amount requested in GBP. For HOURLY billing this is hourlyRate x (hours + minutes / 60); for FIXED_RATE it is the flat fee entered by the provider.

costsSharedWithOtherParties.description: Whether the expert's costs are shared with other parties.

apportionment.description: How the costs are split. Required when costsSharedWithOtherParties is true; omitted when false.

ExpertDetails.description: The expert and what they will cost.

expertFullName.description: Full name of the expert the prior authority is for.

expertPostcode.description: Primary business postcode of the expert, for regional rate mapping.

PriorAuthoritySubmission.description: Prior-authority request body as submitted to the Access Data Store. The applicationId is taken from the URL path; it does not appear in the body.

priorAuthorityType.description: The category of prior authority being requested.

justification.description: Detailed rationale explaining why funding is necessary.
justification.example: Expert evidence is needed to support the claim.

uploadedDocuments.description: Supporting documents uploaded with the request. Optional for all types.

TimeRequested.description: The amount of the expert's time being requested.

UploadedDocument.description: A document uploaded as supporting evidence for a prior-authority request.

PriorAuthorityApplicationResponse.description: Confirmation returned after a prior-authority application has been submitted.

submissionId.description: Identifier assigned to the prior-authority application by the Access Data Store.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the application was accepted by the Access Data Store.
